items.reason: The calendar list already restricts database credentials to userId: user.id (packages/lib/getConnectedDestinationCalendars.ts:282-290), so team-owned credentials are not exposed through this flow. Persisted delegation credentials also carry the user's ID (packages/lib/server/repository/credential.ts:226), satisfying the new check. In-memory delegation credentials use id: -1 and teamId: null (packages/lib/delegationCredential/server.ts:86-97), so adding team membership authorization would not address those either.
